newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cascade Comm rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cascade Comm rated buy.

text.p: -- JP Morgan said analyst Willliam Rabin initiated coverage of Cascade Communications Corp with a buy rating.
-- estimated earnings of $0.72 per share for 1996 and $1.10 for 1997, versus $0.28 in 1995.

-- said company, one of four vendors that dominate the rapidly expanding computer wide-area-network sector, "has a stronghold on the strategic markets of Internet service providers and communications carriers..."
-- set 12-month price target of 85. Shares gained 1-1/2 to 65-1/4.
